flavor.phonemic_palette: Slavic backbone (palatalization; sibilants sh/zh/ch/shch; dithematic glory-names -slav/-mir; -ov/-ich) with a Germanic overlay (-burg/-mark forts, a few dithematic war-names); theophoric on the Slavic morphs (Marakh-, Tulor-) with Germanic variants (Marahs-, Thulrs-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Germanic + Slavic per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Germanic + Slavic register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'venedan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Venedan — wary tribal of the forest; freedom, strength.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Venedan (Germanic + Slavic) are a assertive tribal people seeded in forest, taiga, swamp. They prize freedom, strength, family, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, marines, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, storms, sea.
